description: Search and filter drafts by keyword (matching title or caption), account id or network, newest updated first, without loading the whole workspace’s drafts. Changes nothing.

accountId.description: Filter to drafts targeting this account id from accounts_list.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

limit.description: Maximum drafts to return, newest updated first. Defaults to 20.

network.description: Filter to drafts targeting this network key, such as "linkedin" or "instagram".

query.description: Case-insensitive text to match against draft titles and variant captions.

name: drafts_search
title: Search drafts
